notes: Corrected: בְּתוֹכָהּ → *in it* is now בְּ+תוֹךְ fused to *in* under rule 30 (headed on תָּוֶךְ) with the suffix taking *it*, replacing the accepted split that left תָּוֶךְ `unrepresented`.
Variant WLC.EZK.14.14.v002 is underdetermined and the projection carries the r00-base reading of דָּנִיֵּאל (s012), which the ASV's *Daniel* permits; no rule 53 case arises.
The restrictive *but* of *deliver but their own souls* is `added`: the verse writes no conjunction in that clause.
Both articles of הָאֲנָשִׁים הָאֵלֶּה go unrepresented, the written demonstrative licensing the single *these*.
